verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant, such as an in-console SQL or ops copilot, is a fair capability for a managed database service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows support for external agents: an MCP server for third-party coding agents, CHKit commands agents can drive, and isolated branches and query logging for agent runs. None of this is an AI assistant built into ObsessionDB that users can delegate tasks to, so these are adjacent features that earn no credit.
